'''Bewwil''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Garnib]], the [[Balinaka]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. It was located in the south-western hemisphere, on the continent of [[Hev]].
